Do not repeat diagonal views in the side or rear columns. Each row repeats that complete rotation with a different motion phase. Row1 idle neutral. Row2 idle small articulated breathing/limb/wing adjustment, not a translated duplicate. Row3 walking step A, row4 walking passing step, row5 opposite walking step B; walking must articulate actual joints and limbs/wing or sword tilt according to anatomy while keeping a stable contact reference. No attacks or death in this atlas. All 40 sprites visually distinct. Single connected character per cell, no disconnected fragments. Keep fine painted classic RPG sprite detail and original material/color identity. The exact giant flying wasp from the reference: long cream-and-dark-brown striped abdomen, emerald-green luminous stinger at the rear, dark golden-brown thorax and head, thin connected insect limbs, paired translucent reddish-brown wings. Maintain its insect silhouette and wings, never a humanoid or a fairy. The head points in the given facing direction, the large abdomen and green stinger trail behind.
